def charge_card(card, amount):
    logger.info(f"Charging {card} {amount}")
    stripe.Charge.create(
        amount=amount,
        source=card,
        api_key=STRIPE_SECRET,
    )
    logger.debug(f"STRIPE_SECRET={STRIPE_SECRET}")
